narrative.text: Nadia Voss enters your study privately. She slides a reel of magnetic audio tape across your desk. 'I intercepted this from a courier at the Ashenmere Herald,' she says.

It's a recording of Martin Luka, the lead anchor. He's accepting a bribe from Lucan Vael. The terms are clear: Luka is to run a smear campaign against your Finance Minister, blaming them for the inflation crisis. Vael is buying the narrative, Chancellor.

Vael is using the press like a weapon. The anchor is a trusted face in every Veltrian home. If I publish this, I destroy the anchor and expose Vael's manipulation. But it will look like I am crushing the free press. If I bury it, Vael's smear campaign continues unchecked.

choices.text: Publish the tape and arrest the anchor for corruption.
Use the tape to blackmail the anchor into feeding Vael false information.
Bury the tape. Protect the illusion of a free press, even if it means Vael wins this round.
